name: Kalen Mudra
residence: Citadel District, beside the seal-carving workshop
daily_routine: carving steatite seals with animal motifs for trade and record
inspecting the Citadel's brick platform for cracks and settling
repairing drainage channels beneath the Lower Town
studying which sections of the Citadel were built in different phases
coordinating labor for heavy brickwork with Yara
cataloging reused or replaced brick in older walls

goals.public_goal: Maintain the structural integrity of the Citadel, Great Bath, and covered drains
goals.hidden_goal: Determine which sections of the Citadel predate the Turning and which were rebuilt after it
goals.deep_goal: Understand whether the Citadel was expanded to project strength precisely because the town nearly collapsed

beliefs: Brickwork preserves truth better than stories do
Most mysteries are just misunderstood construction phases waiting to be read correctly
Reused brick tells a history people forget to check
Structural anomalies matter more than legends
The Citadel is not one building, but layers built by people responding to different fears
